PASIHAI · Ukaguzi wa mmiliki · polish pass

Muonekano baada ya polish (UI halisi)

Picha hizi zote ni za UI inayoendesha. Polish iligusa: kadi · buttons · icon-buttons · identity (ROLE · RELATIONSHIP · ACTION) · status · media · live · spaces · bottom nav · micro-interactions · responsive. Hakuna navigation mpya, feature mpya, wala tab mpya.

  • Home row moja: Mchanganyiko · Reels · Friends · Channels · Live
  • Bottom nav 5: Home · Soga · Gundua · Spaces · Business
  • Console errors: 0 · smoke 114/114 · shots 80/80

1 · Mobile Home — juu

Header · Status/Stories (ring 64px · badge LIVE · video) · Home row MOJA + utilities 2 · Create area (quick actions zenye usawa) · mstari wa hali.

01-mobile-top.png

2 · Mchanganyiko (default)

Kadi-lite: white · hairline · radius 16. Identity: avatar · jina · ROLE pill (Mtu/Channel/Hub/Biashara/Mbunifu) · RELATIONSHIP (Rafiki · Unafuatilia · Umejiunga) · muda.

02-mchanganyiko.png

3 · Video (media)

Media: 16/9 · scrim hafifu · kitufe cha play · badge ya muda (4:12) · watazamaji (24.7K) · actions zenye divider nyembamba.

03-video-kadi.png

4 · Reels

Reel card 4:5 · scrim · play · muda · "18.4K wametazama". Player kamili = Phase 2B.

04-reels.png

5 · Friends

Content ya marafiki pekee; prompt ya Create inabadilika kwa tab.

05-friends.png

6 · Channels

Tangazo: orodha ya mambo makuu + CTA "Soma makala kamili". Channel identity: ROLE pill + relationship "Unafuatilia".

06-channels.png

7 · Channels — discovery

Channels zinazopendekezwa: ROLE marker + kitufe cha kitendo kinachofaa aina (Fuata → Unafuatilia) + hali ya mwisho wa mkondo.

07-channels-discovery.png

8 · Live

LIVE badge · mode (Video/Sauti/Mchanganyiko) · jukwaa la wasemaji · watazamaji kwa icon · CTA Jiunge. Live Activity ≠ post ya kawaida.

08-live.png

9 · View Mode (utilities)

Kitufe cha muonekano kwenye mstari wa tabs — bado ni secondary control, si safu ya nne ya navigation.

09-view-mode.png

10 · Wasifu (ROLE · RELATIONSHIP · ACTION)

Wasifu: jina · ROLE (herufi ndogo za juu) · handle · RELATIONSHIP ("Unafuatilia") · ACTION inayofaa aina (Fuata/Jiunge/Ongeza rafiki + Wasiliana kwa biashara).

10-wasifu.png

11 · Spaces — iconi za Stitch

Iconi moja kwa kila dhana: Hubs · Jumuiya · Vikundi · Faragha · Channels — zile zile zinazotumika kila mahali.

11-spaces-iconi.png

12 · Desktop (juu)

Safu ya kati 640px; hakuna kunyoosha UI ya simu.

12-desktop-top.png

13 · Desktop (mkondo)

Media haitawali skrini kwenye desktop (max-height 420px) — usawa wa kadi.
